description.label: Description
description.value:
Minor Physical Mutation

Small, sharp thorns protrude from your esh all over your body. Your Unarmed and Grappling attacks make +1 Damage. You can also, as an Action, launch a thorn at an opponent up to 10+SB yards away. You deal 1+SL damage on a successful Ballistic Skill Test. You can only wear custom armour. Roll 1d10, on a 8-10 your thorns are poisonous. Gain the @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-core.items.Item.gFkRm9wS65qe18Xv]{Venom (Average)} Creature Trait. You can only gain this mutation once.
